node.statement: If V were infinite, the open cover in node 1.8.1 would have no finite subcover: given finitely many vertices v_1,...,v_n, choose a vertex w outside that finite set. At the point w of |K| one has lambda_v_i(w)=0 for every i, so w is in none of U_v_1,...,U_v_n.
